name: Daily Picks
description: Movies and shows picked every day from what your users watch, as a home row and a library for TV apps.

versions.changelog:
Serve Daily Picks images from local storage, collage as JPEG

Daily Picks posters were read from the media drive next to the links, so on a NAS
every first view of the day was slow on TV apps. After each scan the images are
now saved into Jellyfin's metadata folder and the drive copies deleted (only once
the local file is confirmed). Items whose image record went missing are repaired
from the files on the next refresh.

The library tile collage is saved as JPEG (about 5x smaller than PNG).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Link only the first season of a picked show

A picked show used to get a link, NFO and thumbnail for every episode, which on a
large library meant thousands of NAS writes and a long scan each night. Only the
first regular season with files is linked now (specials if there is nothing else),
and files are only checked for that season.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add library tile image: daily poster collage or your own picture

The Daily Picks library tile (My Media on TV apps) now shows a collage of today's
10 posters with the title, redrawn when the picks change. The settings page can
switch to an uploaded picture (admins only, PNG/JPEG/WebP checked by content),
with a preview of the current tile.

The collage uses the server's SkiaSharp and falls back to Jellyfin's own library
image style if it is missing. Saving settings that don't affect the picks no
longer remakes them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix empty household picks when a user can't see any library

Household picks were limited to titles every enabled user can see, so one account
without library access left nothing to pick and the library was never created.
Only users who can open the Daily Picks library now count. Empty results are no
longer saved for the day, and the log explains why nothing was picked.

Load the catalog and watch history once per refresh, make every user's picks in
the background task, and log how long loading takes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Daily Picks plugin for Jellyfin 12.4

Daily movie and show picks based on what users watch: a home row in the web client
and a hard-linked library for native TV apps. Includes taste engine tests and a
release workflow that publishes to a Jellyfin plugin catalog (manifest.json).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
